citeturn27search10 [wordlim: 200] Published: 6 months ago; Crawled: last month; Baystreet Staff - Wednesday, May 13, 2026 ... Wall Street investment bank Morgan Stanley (MS) has raised its year-end target for the benchmark S&P 500 stock market index.

The New York-based bank lifted its year-end target for the S&P 500 to 8,000 from 7,800 previously.
